item.title: This is cute! Four acres in Kentucky. $160,000
item.description: This is a cute house! It has some nice acreage with it. The house was built in 1938. It is located on four acres in London, Kentucky. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, wood walls, crown moulding, baseboards and a cute kitchen. There are two detached buildings on the property and both have electric. The property also has a carport. One bedroom, one bathroom and 804 square feet. $160,000 Contact William Hibbitts with Shawn Rogers Realty: 606-231-9586 From the Zillow l

item.title: Love the sunroom! Circa 1929 in Louisiana. $184,500
item.description: I love the sunroom! I would always be in there. The house was built in 1929. It is located on .25 acre in Opelousas, Louisiana. The house features an arched front door, original wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, spacious kitchen, crystal chandelier, sunroom and solid wood doors with original hardware. There is a fenced in backyard with a fireplace and carport. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,250 square feet. $184,500 Contact Charles Hiller with Parish Realty Acadiana: 337-735-1223 From

item.title: Former schoolhouse in Maine! Circa 1853. $275,000
item.description: This is a former schoolhouse! It’s a big space with over 6,000 square feet! The schoolhouse was built in 1853. It is located on .6 acre in Stockton Springs, Maine. The school features a bell tower, soaring ceilings and lots of windows for natural light. There are lots of possibilities with this building. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 6,244 square feet. $275,000 Contact RE/MAX Jaret and Cohn: belfast@jaretcohn.com From the Zillow listing: Bring your vision to this remarkable 1853 schoolhouse.

item.title: Nice mountain retreat! C. 1946 in North Carolina. $190,000
item.description: Nice mountain retreat in North Carolina! Love the setting and how about that kitchen sink! The cabin was built in 1946. It is located on .1/2 acre in Black Mountain, North Carolina. The cabin features a covered front porch, wood floors, wood walls, gas logs, vintage sink and two porch swings. Some of the square footage must not be included, probably due to ceiling height. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 576 square feet. $190,000 Contact Matthew Rice with Howard Hanna Beverly-Hanks Asheville: rice

item.description: This house has a pretty interior! Nice yard also. The house was built in 1927. It is located on .33 acre in Hopewell, Virginia. item.title: Pretty interior! A lot of natural light! One acre in Massachusetts. $238,000
item.description: This house has a lot of natural light! The kitchen is nice! The house was built in 1941. It is located on one acre in Hardwick, Massachusetts. The house features wood floors, vaulted ceiling, updated bathroom, exposed beams and a loft area. There is a firepit and raised garden beds on the property. One bedroom, one bathroom and 742 square feet. $238,000 Contact Lauren Mace with William Neylon Real Estate: 508-688-1125 From the Zillow listing: Discover the charm of this cozy 1-bed, 1-bath ranch n

item.title: This has character! Circa 1871 in Michigan. $299,900
item.description: This house has character! Loving the exterior details! The house was built in 1871. It is located on .35 acre in Romeo, Michigan. The house features a wrap around front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, arched entryway, exposed brick in the kitchen, vaulted ceiling, claw foot tub and built-in. The backyard is fenced with a large patio and a detached two car garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,902 square feet. $299,900 Contact Michael Mason with The Agency Hall and Hunter: 248-762-5

item.title: Pretty woodwork and pocket doors! C. 1898 in Minnesota. $285,000
item.description: This house has some pretty woodwork and pocket doors! Nice staircase! The house was built in 1898. It is located in St. Peter, Minnesota. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, nice staircase, pocket doors, stained glass windows, built-in seating, bay windows and baseboards. There is a detached garage behind the house. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,830 square feet. $285,000 Contact Shari Brostrom with Pell Real Estate From the Zillow listing: Welcome to 310 N Minnes

item.title: Look inside! That closet is amazing! Two acres in Mississippi. $325,000
item.description: This house has a lot of amazing details! I want that closet! The pool is nice too. This seems like a lot of house for the money! The house was built in 1933. It is located on two acres in Ruleville, Mississippi. The house features a porte cochere, beautiful crystal chandelier, wood floors, built-ins, original windows, knotty pine, french doors, arched entryways, breakfast room, game room, amazing master bathroom and a huge master closet. Outside there is a large pool and poolhouse. Four bedrooms
